senses.gloss:
I. 6 Ā. (प्रियते-पृत) To be busy or active (mostly with व्या); कार्ये व्याप्रियते; see व्यापृत. -Caus (पारयति-ते) 
__1 To cause to work, engage upon, entrust, with, appoint to; (usually with loc.); व्यापारितः शूलमृता बिधाय सिंहत्वमङ्कागतसत्त्ववृत्ति [[R. 2. 38.]] 
__2 To place, set, fix, direct, cast; व्यापारयामास करं किरीटे [[R. 6. 19]]; उमामुखे … व्यापारयामास विलोचनानि [[Ku. 3. 67]]; व्यापारितं शिरसि शस्त्रमशस्त्रपाणेः [[Ve. 3. 19]]; [[R. 13. 25.]] --II. 3 P. (पिपर्ति, पूर्ण) 
__1 To bring or carry over. 
__2 To deliver from, bring out of. 
__3 To fill. 
__4 To protect, maintain, sustain. 
__5 To promote, advance. --III. 9 P. (पृणाति) To protect. --IV. 10 [[U.]] (पारयति-ते; sometimes पार् is regarded as a separate root.) 
__1 To carry over or across, ferry over. 
__2 To reach the other side of anything, accomplish, perform, achieve, bring to a conclusion (a vow &c.). 
__3 To be able or capable; न खलु मातापितरौ भर्तृवियोगदुःखितां दुहितरं द्रष्टुं पारयतः [[Ś. 6]]; न पारयामि तातकाश्यपस्य … आपन्नसत्त्वां शकुन्तलां निवेदयितुम् [[Ś. 4]]; अधिकं न हि पारयामि वक्तुम् [[Bv. 2. 59.]] 
__4 To deliver, save, extricate, rescue. 
__5 To withstand, oppose. 
__6 To live; [[V. 5]] P. (पृणोति) 
__1 To please or delight, gratify. 
__2 To be pleased or delighted.

€3, 9 P. (पिपर्ति, पृणाति, पपार, अपारीत्, परि-री-ष्यति, परि-री-तुम्, पूर्ण; pass. पूर्यते; caus. पूरयति-ते; desid. पिपरिरी-षति, पुपूर्षति) 
__1 To fill, fill up, complete. 
__2 To fulfil, gratify (as hopes &c.). 
__3 To fill with wind, blow (as a conch, flute &c.). 
__4 To satisfy, refresh, please; पितॄनपारात् [[Bk. 1. 2.]] 
__5 To rear, bring up, nourish, nurture, cherish.
